text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training was progressing 
smoothly toward achieving the Classic 
Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Without warning, "it" struck.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Incoming! —Get down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting out a roar, Orfevre loomed over, 
shielding me. Watching her protect the 
weak, before I had time to process 
anything—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Painted over with fear. The violent 
shaking, as if heaven and earth had 
swapped places, continued for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unprecedented earthquake disaster. It 
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It changed everything.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! The road is cracked over here too...! 
I've never seen anything like this 
before...

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Still, the disaster area must be even 
worse... ...Why did something like this 
have to happen...?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? This shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
............It's calmed down... Phew... My 
heart was pounding...

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right? There might be 
aftershocks. Let's head somewhere 
safe...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The aftershocks of the disaster naturally 
reached the racing world as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
More and more races are getting canceled, 
aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the racetracks in the 
disaster-stricken areas are in no 
condition to be used.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...An overseas expedition? This is hardly 
the time for that... geez.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's gonna happen... to my 
Classic races too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My goal starts from the Derby... but 
Orfe-san is aiming for the Triple Crown... 
If it gets cancelled--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Idiot, at a time like this... I'm the 
worst...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. At a time like this, 
thinking about races, of all things...――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
âAh, this commercial again... I feel 
like I've been seeing it everywhere 
lately.
choice_data_list:
True, it's been like that ever since the 
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the days following the earthquake 
disaster, the TV broadcasted footage of 
the damage day after day. With each 
passing day, the scale of it only seemed 
to grow...
choice_data_list:
Ah... I took a trip over there a long time 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I visited there during training once 
before as well... I wonder how everyone is 
doing...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, can I turn off the TV? It's 
getting a bit painful to watch..."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. ...My family is originally from 
around there. I was able to get in touch 
with them, but...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"It's pathetic of me to act like this when 
I'm the one who came out unscathed. ...I 
feel ashamed of myself."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're not pathetic in the slightest. I 
mean, what happened this time was just way 
too much... ...Let's, um, change the 
subject—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you know... We shouldn't—we can't 
just look away, right?"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Let alone forgetting everything... and 
just having fun."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Confusion, agitation, shock... Shortly 
after those feelings, what began to drift 
among the public was— a "mood of 
self-restraint," born of empathy for the 
disaster victims.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not just races, but lives, events, 
ceremonies... all entertainment has been 
put on hold.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone thinks it's inappropriate... 
given the situation, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right? Lives come first. Entertainment... 
isn't for "right now."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
—You're quitting the band...?! Why?! We 
were just starting to fill bigger venues!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started, right!? Once 
things settle down a bit—

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Once things settle down, then what? Will 
the customers come back? ...Just like 
before?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
...Well... Things might not go the same 
way they used to, but—

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"...You know that fan who always travels 
from afar and says, 'I came from somewhere 
cold'?"

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Her hometown was around the area featured 
on the news today. Did you know?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: ...!! Huh... n-no way...

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
I don't know that much about it. Don't 
even know their real name. ...Still, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, in this situation... there's 
no way we should be doing a live show 
right now.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but... still! Isn't 
right now the time we oughta do it?!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"They came to love our music and called it 
a place they belong... so if we ended up 
losing that—"

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Could you say that to her face? ...To a 
kid who might've actually lost her place 
to live?

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"A concert... What's the point of that... 
right now?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
...! Then! I'll go all the way over to her 
and play music――

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm tellin' you that's just shovin' your 
own ideals on her!! Can music fill her 
stomach?! Can it... keep that kid warm?!"

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Everything's already changed. Music... 
isn't gonna do anything to help you 
survive."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: “Still... but music has power—”

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
What is the power of music, anyway? 
...Hey, right now... what can we even do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Attention, Trainers! In light of this 
earthquake, the URA is currently 
deliberating its response!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Some may be in difficult situations. 
However, please, I beg of you, support the 
Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The staff must unite as one to overcome 
this hardship...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However... once daily life is shattered, 
the anxiety of an uncertain future cannot 
be wiped away overnight."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder what will become of us from 
here on out."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Our race... Lady Orfe's Triple Crown... 
At this rate..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being in a position of adult 
responsibility, I'm at a loss for words. I 
must approach this with even more care 
than usual...
choice_data_list: (I can't talk about hope so easily...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, Orfevre too... had 
been lost in thought. With an unreadable 
expression, completely silent...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...About time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Trainer. We're making our move.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Make haste, and arrange a press 
conference.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To the lost masses, I deliver the imperial 
decree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing the sheer intensity in Orfevre's 
gaze... I hastily arranged the press 
conference and ushered the press corps in.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...A fairly good turnout, I see.
choice_data_list:
You really won't tell me what you're 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can tell she wants to offer words of 
comfort as a king to the anxious people. 
And that she possesses a strong will. 
However—
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, let me come with you—
As your Trainer, let me come along too—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Unwanted interference.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I make no mistakes. That is why I am 
'King.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a single day, the world turned into 
something uncertain. While so many people 
are left bewildered, Orfevre... remains 
completely unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fear is the natural law of all living 
beings.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that is impossible for me. —It could 
never be.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King is providence itself, absolute 
and supreme. What is there to fear?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Follow me. Where I tread, the path 
shall open of its own accord.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press conference hall was filled with 
murmurs. Whatever their position, everyone 
was feeling downcast right now. Through 
that oppressive air... Orfevre cuts 
straight through.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hear me, my people.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My indignation knows no bounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A quiet anger... yet strangely, there was 
no hostility in it to intimidate the 
listener. All that was there was a pure, 
unadulterated rage against injustice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What displeases me... is the demon nesting 
within your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My heart belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall not allow anyone to surrender it 
to the darkness.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The only time you lower your gaze... is 
when you kneel before me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Hear ye, my subjects.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: By royal decree. Raise your head.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And now, behold my running! This is light!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Prostrate yourselves and worship. I shall 
illuminate you all, far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The press conference room was now dead 
silent. No one dared to breathe... as if 
desperately trying to digest her words.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I passed along the message.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Polish that crown of yours well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was aimed straight at me... No, at me 
and the URA emblem right behind me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The footage of Orfevre's press conference 
was widely broadcasted to the public by 
the shocked media... sparking praise and 
criticism alike.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't that so selfish?! Holding a press 
conference like that right now. Isn't the 
Trainer just as guilty?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... During such a difficult time... 
It's inappropriate. ...But—

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
What Orfevre's doing basically means 
holding a race, right? It's not really the 
right situation for that, though...

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
...Still. It's hard to say, but... I 
was... happy. —Because I felt like I saw a 
light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps spurred on by the public 
excitement surrounding Orfevre's press 
conference... after much debate, the URA 
finalized their policy as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Report! The spring races are resuming!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Races scheduled in heavily damaged areas 
will be hosted by less affected venues 
instead! Fundraising will also take place 
on site!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...We are the ones who must believe that 
racing holds power. We must never halt our 
stride!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—I shall forge ahead! Let's 
believe in the power of racing!

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Kneel and revere me. I shall illuminate 
you all."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
……You're going to run? Right now……? Is 
there…… any point to doing that? 
—Orfevre……

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Has it been decided?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the report. Good work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the races are resuming now... we'll 
make it in time for the Satsuki Sho 
afterwards. Which means—
choice_data_list:
Looks like we can enter the Classic Triple 
Crown races.

Looks like we can enter the Classic Triple 
Crown races, huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning, it was destined 
to be so.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to crown this head... 
with what rightfully belongs there.
choice_data_list:
(Surely that sight... will illuminate 
people's hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Doubt still lingers. In times like 
these, I do not know if racing is truly 
the right thing to do. But...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You should know my power. Hesitate not. 
—Obey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Have faith in the power of racing. If you 
achieve the great feat of the Classic 
Triple Crown, it will become a shining 
light... giving courage to so many people.
choice_data_list: (If it's Orfevre... he can do it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My duty is to guide things to their 
rightful shape... To lead the chosen king 
straight to glory. For her sake—and for 
the future of racing.
